description: Complete a sprint of a project's board: EVERY issue of the sprint not in a done state leaves it — into the backlog, or into another sprint of the same board with 'moveTo' — and the sprint is closed with today's completion date; done issues stay in it. Call it with apply=false first (the default): the answer says what it would do and changes nothing — 'done', 'moving', 'staying', per project, and where they go — and with apply=true it does exactly that. An issue of a paused or archived project stays in the closed sprint and is named in 'stays'; issues in projects you cannot open are only counted ('hidden'). Every issue that leaves gets a line in its history in your name; the applied plan's 'changeId' is one set of changes — rollback_sprint_change opens the sprint again and puts them back. Needs full write access to the project (member, admin or lead); a reporter, a commenter or a read-only member is refused with the reason, as is anybody while the project is paused.

apply.description: false (the default) answers what completing would do and changes nothing. true does it.

moveTo.description: Where the unfinished issues go: 'backlog' (the default), or another sprint of the same board that is not closed, by name or id.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board holds the sprint, e.g. 'PM'.

sprint.description: The sprint, by name or id. Left out: the board's active sprint.
